events.verdict: Jakucionis (MIA) moves laterally into Mitchell's (OKC) path and initiates contact with Mitchell's (OKC) body, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Holmgren (OKC) directly contests Adebayo's (MIA) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Adebayo's (MIA) hand after the release.
Powell (MIA) and Mitchell (OKC) mutually engage and immediately disengage as marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Caruso (OKC) establishes himself in Wiggins' (MIA) path and marginal contact occurs during the pick.

Larsson (MIA) is drawn into the air on the pump fake towards Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC), and contact occurs to Gilgeous-Alexander's body during his upward shooting motion. Gilgeous-Alexander does not overtly jump towards Larsson to initiate the contact, therefore a shooting foul on Larsson should have been assessed instead.
Adebayo (MIA) establishes himself in Caruso's (OKC) path and marginal contact occurs during the pick.
Mitchell (OKC) initiates body contact with Adebayo (MIA) that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Wiggins (MIA) and Caruso (OKC) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Caruso (OKC) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Caruso (OKC) directly contests Wiggins' (MIA) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Wiggins' (MIA) hand after the release.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) is already in Adebayo's (MIA) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the screen.
Smith (MIA) jumps to defend the lob pass, and marginal contact occurs with Holmgren (OKC) during his play at the basket.
Powell (MIA) establishes positive frontcourt position, and his right foot makes contact with the midcourt line while he is in possession of the ball.
Wallace (OKC) legally contests Wiggins' (MIA) jump shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) legally contests Caruso's (OKC) jump shot attempt.
